reason: E1 shows that high-temperature short-range ordering and chemical clustering occur in a model HEA, supporting the existence of local order from pair interactions, but neither E1 nor E2 provides evidence that this order suppresses diffusional phase separation or acts as a diffusion barrier. The key mechanistic link between local order and enhanced stability is unsupported by the cited evidence.
premises: High configurational entropy stabilizes a disordered solid solution at high temperatures
Favorable atomic pair interactions initiate local chemical (short-range) order
Emergent short-range order acts as a barrier to diffusion, suppressing phase separation
The competition between entropy and pair interactions governs structural stability
